title: Edit tool can report failure while the change already applies
body: The ml_test.py suffix edit and all three tf-import edits first returned 'Could not find oldString', but re-reading each file showed the suffix WAS on disk (status flipped to M). Retrying on disk truth instead of the error message is mandatory; a blind retry would double-suffix the line. Verify by re-read/line-print before any second attempt.

title: Malformed shell command slipped into a parallel batch
body: One batched shell call was sent as a half-constructed path (python ...tools/../.githooks/../../../c). It was harmless because the spine only ran 'exit 0', but the class risk is a masked bad exit. A command string must be complete and self-sufficient before send; exit 0 must never be appended to make garbage 'pass'.

title: Unclaimed file set shrank 16-to-6 in 15 minutes; re-derive ownership at stage time
body: The 11:07 report left 16 diagnostic files unclaimed; by 11:20 foreign-lane git status showed 10 more files mid-edit (ECOSYSTEM_TEST, enhanced_qlearning, jax_analysis, comprehensive_analysis, PSYCHE/distill, PythonSystemMapper, PERSEPHONE, consciousness, qwen35_ssm, session_memory) then also tests/test_ml_estimators.py seconds after a clean status. Slice was remapped to the 5 files that stayed unclaimed; ownership must be re-derived by git status immediately before git add, not at slice-planning time.

title: WORMZ_POPUP.py is the structural producer pattern for Popen.stdout narrowing
body: For 'for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, "")' reportOptionalMemberAccess, the tree already contains the structural fix in CORE/WORMS/WORMZ_POPUP.py L88-90: bind stdout = process.stdout, then 'if stdout is None: raise RuntimeError(...)'. Root METAWORMS_POPUP.py was fixed by copying that exact shape instead of the META twin's ignore comment - plus the twin is foreign-owned mid-edit.

title: Report anchors are a snapshot; line text must be re-grepped before editing
body: Two anchors in logs/basedpyright_report.json (hydra_success, best_trial, best_params = test_hydrometa(); [len(self.replay_buffer) - 1], [priority]) no longer exist in worktree lines 15 minutes later - the foreign lane had already fixed those sites. The report is per-run evidence, not live tree state; every anchor must be re-verified by grep/read immediately before edit.

title: type: ignore with a pyright rule name DOES suppress - proven by narrowed run
body: Doubt existed because two comment lines still appeared in the 11:07 report (META twin and test_ml_estimators), so the suffix form was tested empirically on ml_test.py: a narrowed --check --only run over the 5 files returned '0 errors / 0 warnings over 5 files' and 'no new diagnostics', proving the form suppresses in this basedpyright. Proof for a file is the analyzed run's own count, not the (stale-baseline-wide) 'no longer reported' list, which also lists unanalyzed files.
